text.title: Burning Harbor
text.body: Act III Climax — Under a blood-crimson sky choked with volcanic ash, mutinous raiders and cinder-beasts breach Harborwatch's seawall. Clear the Burning Plaza, hold the Western Evacuation Pier beside Harbor Marshal Veyra until the last iron-plated caravels sail west, then storm the Eastern War Pier to slay Lord-Captain Korvus, 'The Iron Anchor'.
text.obj.0: Clear the Burning Plaza and hold the Western Evacuation Pier
text.obj.1: Storm the Eastern War Pier and slay Lord-Captain Korvus ('The Iron Anchor')
text.obj.2: Keep Harbor Marshal Veyra alive at the evacuation pier
text.msg.1: Harbor bells are clanging through the ash-smoke! Clear the burning plaza and relieve the Western Evacuation Pier before mutineers overrun Marshal Veyra and the final caravels!
text.msg.2: Hold the western gangplank, Commander! Two more caravels are still taking on children from Sera's tents—Miner Gorin's ironstone plates are holding, nothing with a torch crosses these flagstones!
text.msg.3: They are away! May the salt winds carry them past the Western Rim! The garrison's reserve treasury of one thousand gold is yours—now, Commander, let us show Korvus and his vultures how the rearguard of Thornvael fights!
text.msg.4: The ships are already beyond his reach—Lord-Captain Korvus, 'The Iron Anchor', topples with his twin chains into the churning black surf!
text.msg.5: The people are safe. Their dawn is on the water. We have bought them their morning—now let us march east into the night of the Obsidian Caldera!
text.npc.orson: The Sanctuary School still preserves apex spell scrolls—Meteor Shower, Chain Lightning, Resurrection—and Miner Gorin's smiths have plated the hulls. Trade what ancestral bullion you need before forcing the burning plaza.
text.win: Lord-Captain Korvus sinks beneath the black surf, the evacuation armada sails untouched beyond the Western Rim, and the rearguard turns east toward the Obsidian Caldera.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell amidst the flames of Burning Harbor.
text.fail.2: Harbor Marshal Veyra fell and the evacuation pier was lost.
